nigeria.title: Flag of Nigeria
desc: - Three vertical stripes of green, white, and green, designed by Michael Taiwo Akinkunmi. Selected from 2,870 entries in a 1959 national competition
trivia:
- The green represents the forests and agriculture; white represents peace and unity
- The colours were chosen to represent national identity beyond tribal or ethnic divisions
- Nigeria adopted this flag in 1960 upon independence; it has influenced many other African nations' flag designs
